name: Wishio – Wishlist Addon for WooCommerce
author: scalarwp

sections.description:
Wishio adds a fast, flexible wishlist to your WooCommerce store. Shoppers save the products they love with one click — logged in or as guests — and come back to buy them later. You get a clear picture of what your customers want most, so you can stock, price, and promote with confidence.

No setup headaches: activate, place the button, done. Guests can build a wishlist without an account, and everything they saved merges into their profile automatically when they log in or register.

Shopper experience

  • One-click add-to-wishlist button on shop, product, and archive pages, with a save confirmation popup.
  • A dedicated wishlist page, plus a Wishlist tab in the WooCommerce account dashboard, with a product table showing image, name, price, and stock status.
  • Per-row Add to Cart and Buy Now (straight to checkout) actions — each can be toggled on or off.
  • Guest wishlist — visitors can save products without creating an account.
  • Optional floating wishlist button with a live saved-item count in the page corner.
  • Show the wishlist icon on related / similar product cards.
  • Optional guest email prompt — ask guests for their email after they save a set number of products.

Easy placement

  • Button Designer — customize the button icon, style, size, position, text, and colors, plus the save-popup styling, with a live preview.
  • Shortcodes — [wishio_wc_wishlist_button] (button), [wishio_wishlist] (wishlist page), and [wishio_wc_wishlist_count] (live saved-item count anywhere).
  • Gutenberg block for dropping the wishlist button into page content.
  • Elementor widgets — a wishlist button widget and a wishlist-aware products widget.

Insights for store owners

  • Overview dashboard with wishlist KPIs at a glance.
  • Demand report — your most-wishlisted products and variants.
  • Activity report — items added and removed, and engagement over time.
  • Wishlist customers — see which shoppers have saved items.

Built for WooCommerce

  • HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage) compatible.
  • Translation-ready.
  • Lightweight and inert when WooCommerce isn’t active — no fatals, just a friendly notice.

Go further with Wishio Wishlist Pro

Upgrade to unlock revenue-driving features:

  • Email alerts — automatic price-drop and back-in-stock emails, item-added confirmations, and scheduled “you still have items saved” reminders, with alert batching.
  • Wishlist sharing — a public share link and shared wishlist page for every list (Facebook, X, Pinterest, WhatsApp, email).
  • Multiple wishlists per customer (e.g. “Birthday ideas”, “Kitchen refresh”).
  • Suggested items — a “shoppers also saved” list ranked from real store demand.
  • Sales attribution — credit revenue and orders back to wishlisted products.
  • Opportunities workspace — restock demand, price-drop-ready, high-intent, stale saves, and guest recovery, ranked by impact.
  • Advanced reports — Attribution, Analytics, and Notification performance.
  • Guest conversion — email verification (OTP), require-login-to-save, and a guest reward coupon.
  • Integrations — FluentCRM (events, contact wishlist tab, automation triggers, smartcodes) and Mailchimp.
  • AI Agent Access (MCP) — let AI assistants query your wishlist data in plain language.

Learn more at scalarwp.com.
sections.installation:
1. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  2. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it from Plugins → Add New in your dashboard.
  3. Activate Wishio – Wishlist Addon for WooCommerce through the Plugins menu.
  4. Open Wishio Wishlist in the admin menu to configure the button, guest behavior, and designer.
  5. The wishlist button appears on your products automatically. Use the shortcodes, block, or Elementor widgets for custom placement.
sections.faq:
Does it work without a customer account?

Yes. Guests can save products without logging in. When a guest later logs in or registers, everything they saved merges into their account automatically.

Where does the wishlist button appear?

On shop, product, and archive pages by default. You can also place it anywhere with the [wishio_wc_wishlist_button] shortcode, the Gutenberg block, or the Elementor widget, and optionally show it on related product cards and as a floating corner button.

Can I customize how the button looks?

Yes. The built-in Button Designer lets you change the icon, style, size, position, text, and colors, plus the save-popup styling, with a live preview.

Does it support HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage)?

Yes. Wishio declares HPOS compatibility and never touches the legacy order tables directly.

What do I get with Pro?

Email alerts (price drop, back in stock, reminders), wishlist sharing, multiple wishlists per customer, suggested items, sales attribution, an opportunities workspace, FluentCRM and Mailchimp integrations, guest conversion tools, and AI Agent (MCP) access. See the Description for the full list.

Is it translation-ready?

Yes. All strings are translatable via the wishio-wishlist-addon-for-woocommerce text domain.

  • Guest wishlist with automatic merge into the account on login or registration.
  • Button Designer, shortcodes, Gutenberg block, and Elementor widgets.
  • Overview, Demand, Activity reports, and the Wishlist customers view.
  • HPOS compatible and translation-ready.

The Wishlist customers report — everyone who saved a product, ranked by engagement, with items added, purchased, and wishlist revenue.
The add-to-wishlist heart button on WooCommerce shop and archive product cards.
The Opportunities workspace (Pro) — a High Impact list of the products closest to converting, with restock, price-drop, and stale tags and one-click alerts.
Guest wishlist settings — set a save limit, require email with one-time-code verification, and reward guests with a coupon (Pro).
The Button Designer — choose where the wishlist button appears and how it looks, with a live shop-grid preview.
Email alerts (Pro) — edit the price-drop, back-in-stock, item-added, and reminder emails with shortcodes.
Email alert preview (Pro) — the rendered price-drop email shoppers receive, with product prices and stock.
Integrations (Pro) — send wishlist events to FluentCRM with per-feed triggers, lists, and tags.
The Demand report — the products shoppers want most, ranked by saves, with a top-variant breakdown.
The Attribution report (Pro) — orders and revenue from the wishlist, split by direct and email channels, with top products and customers.
The storefront guest email popup — visitors verify their email with a one-time code to keep saving, with an optional reward offer.
The wishlist in the WooCommerce account dashboard — Add to Cart and Buy Now actions, stock status, shareable lists, and suggested items (Pro).
